from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import timedelta as td

from django.utils.timezone import now

from hc.api.models import Check
from hc.test import BaseTestCase


class ListChecksStatusFilterTestCase(BaseTestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        super().setUp()

        self.check_new = Check(project=self.project, name="New Check")
        self.check_new.status = "new"
        self.check_new.save()

        self.check_up = Check(project=self.project, name="Up Check")
        self.check_up.status = "up"
        self.check_up.last_ping = now()
        self.check_up.save()

        self.check_down = Check(project=self.project, name="Down Check")
        self.check_down.status = "down"
        self.check_down.save()

        self.check_paused = Check(project=self.project, name="Paused Check")
        self.check_paused.status = "paused"
        self.check_paused.save()

    def get_v3(self, status: str) -> object:
        return self.client.get(
            f"/api/v3/checks/?status={status}", HTTP_X_API_KEY="X" * 32
        )

    def test_filter_by_status_down(self) -> None:
        r = self.get_v3("down")
        self.assertEqual(r.status_code, 200)
        doc = r.json()
        self.assertEqual(len(doc["checks"]), 1)
        self.assertEqual(doc["checks"][0]["name"], "Down Check")

    def test_filter_by_status_up(self) -> None:
        r = self.get_v3("up")
        self.assertEqual(r.status_code, 200)
        doc = r.json()
        names = [c["name"] for c in doc["checks"]]
        self.assertIn("Up Check", names)
        for check in doc["checks"]:
            self.assertEqual(check["status"], "up")

    def test_filter_by_status_new(self) -> None:
        r = self.get_v3("new")
        self.assertEqual(r.status_code, 200)
        doc = r.json()
        self.assertEqual(len(doc["checks"]), 1)
        self.assertEqual(doc["checks"][0]["name"], "New Check")

    def test_filter_by_status_paused(self) -> None:
        r = self.get_v3("paused")
        self.assertEqual(r.status_code, 200)
        doc = r.json()
        self.assertEqual(len(doc["checks"]), 1)
        self.assertEqual(doc["checks"][0]["name"], "Paused Check")

    def test_filter_returns_empty_when_no_match(self) -> None:
        # No checks are in "grace" state in this test setup
        r = self.get_v3("grace")
        self.assertEqual(r.status_code, 200)
        doc = r.json()
        self.assertEqual(len(doc["checks"]), 0)

    def test_invalid_status_returns_400(self) -> None:
        r = self.get_v3("invalid")
        self.assertEqual(r.status_code, 400)
        self.assertIn("error", r.json())

    def test_status_filter_ignored_on_v1(self) -> None:
        # ?status= is only honoured on v3; v1 should return all checks
        r = self.client.get(
            "/api/v1/checks/?status=down", HTTP_X_API_KEY="X" * 32
        )
        self.assertEqual(r.status_code, 200)
        doc = r.json()
        # All 4 checks should be returned, not just the "down" one
        self.assertEqual(len(doc["checks"]), 4)

    def test_status_filter_ignored_on_v2(self) -> None:
        # ?status= is only honoured on v3; v2 should return all checks
        r = self.client.get(
            "/api/v2/checks/?status=down", HTTP_X_API_KEY="X" * 32
        )
        self.assertEqual(r.status_code, 200)
        doc = r.json()
        self.assertEqual(len(doc["checks"]), 4)

    def test_filter_by_status_started(self) -> None:
        # A check that is currently "started" (has recent last_start)
        check_started = Check(project=self.project, name="Started Check")
        check_started.status = "up"
        check_started.last_ping = now()
        check_started.last_start = now()
        check_started.grace = td(hours=1)
        check_started.save()

        r = self.get_v3("started")
        self.assertEqual(r.status_code, 200)
        doc = r.json()
        names = [c["name"] for c in doc["checks"]]
        self.assertIn("Started Check", names)
        for check in doc["checks"]:
            self.assertEqual(check["status"], "started")
